monsters.name: Knife-Guard
monsters.text: One of the Regent's Knives, in green velvet over steel, with a rapier and a long knife and the bored eyes of someone who has done this before and been paid well for it.

monsters.name: Stair cutthroat
monsters.text: A thin, hungry figure in a scarf and three coats, with a knife held low. Lowtown has been cold for a long time, and some people stopped asking nicely.

monsters.name: Aqueduct drowned
monsters.text: Something that was once a person, waterlogged and grey, with black briar grown out through its mouth like a tongue. The old aqueduct is full of the city's dead, and the cold has woken some of them.

monsters.name: Thorn-rat swarm
monsters.text: Fifty rats moving as one grey carpet, every one of them with a thorn grown out of its spine. They make no sound at all.

monsters.name: Cathedral gargoyle
monsters.text: A stone grotesque from the cathedral gutters, wings folded, face like a laughing dog. The Collegium bound it to guard the old archive a century ago and nobody ever told it to stop.

monsters.name: The Glass Warden
monsters.text: A tall figure of Collegium glass, clear as ice, with a lantern burning where its heart should be. It keeps the Quiet Cells quiet. It was designed, you realise, by someone with very elegant handwriting.

on_defeat.message: The Glass Warden comes apart like a dropped decanter, and the lantern in its chest gutters out. Behind it, the cell doors stand in a row, and in one of them something stirs.

monsters.name: Lord Regent Varric Caul
monsters.text: A lean grey man of sixty in a black coat, holding a dying red stone in one hand and a long knife in the other. Frost forms in the air around him, and the stone drinks the heat out of the room to keep him standing.

on_defeat.message: The knife skitters away across the frosted floor. Varric Caul goes down on one knee, and the heart-stone rolls out of his hand and stops against your boot, warm as a coal.
